ingredientSections.heading: Hopped East Van Vodka
items: 1 750ml bottle Odd Society East Van Vodka

methodSections.heading: Lord of the Hops
steps: Add all ingredients to cocktail shaker, shake and strain, into a coupe.

methodSections.heading: Hopped East Van Vodka
steps: You can find Mosaic Hops at a homebrew store. Fill a large mason jar with the Vodka, add the hops, place the lid on tightly and give the jar a big shake.
Let the hops infuse for 2 hours, shaking a few times. Do not over infuse.
Strain the vodka through fine mesh strainer, tea strainer or coffee filter. Make sure all the hops are out of the vodka.

methodSections.heading: Hemlock Syrup
steps: You can forage for hemlock fronds, which are often found on the ground after a storm. If you do take from a tree, choose one that will not be harmed by you trimming a few branches. When using foraged ingredients be mindful of you impact upon the land and its people. To be clear, we are talking about the Hemlock Tree, not the Hemlock Plant which is a much smaller bush and very poisonous.
Place the hemlock fronds you have collected in a paper bag, let them dry out. You will notice the needles fall off easily after a few days.
Place all ingredients in a pan and bring to the boil, remove from heat and let cool over night.
Strain out the leaves, and bottle.
